lead: Since 2008, Refrigerated Trailer Services Limited (RTS) has been a trusted specialist in the temperature-controlled transport sector. Based in Merthyr Tydfil and serving the entire UK and Europe, we excel in the sale, purchase, and rental of new and used refrigerated trailers.

With decades of combined experience, our skilled team can source trailers for any requirement—whether that’s single units, entire fleets, or bespoke configurations. As the UK agent for Lamberet, we supply new trailers, parts, and servicing underpinned by Lamberet’s renowned standard of quality. We pride ourselves on offering a complete solution for your refrigerator trailer needs:
solution: Flexible rental: short-term spot hire or long-term contracts
Secure storage (available in York and Oxford, with capacity for up to 500 trailers)
Access to a UK-wide network of repairers and refrigeration engineers
Sourcing of both new and refurbished parts and refrigeration units
more: Operating from our Merthyr Tydfil base, our multilingual team (English, Spanish, Dutch, and Turkish) leverages a robust European supplier network to locate even the most specialised trailers. Whether you're looking to buy, sell, rent, or maintain, trust RTS to deliver tailored, reliable service—every time.

We are proud to be recognised as one of the leading specialists in refrigerated trailer hire, sales, and exports in South Wales and across the UK. Our customers value us not just for our extensive stock but for our honest advice and tailored service. Whether you are purchasing a single trailer, arranging a long-term hire, or exporting units abroad, our team works closely with you to deliver a solution that meets both operational and budget requirements.

Over the years, RTS has built a reputation for excellence in trailer servicing, maintenance, and repairs, helping businesses keep their fleets on the road and operating efficiently. With access to a wide range of trailer parts, refrigeration units, and trusted repair engineers, we provide a complete end-to-end service. This commitment to quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction has made us a trusted partner for refrigerated transport solutions throughout the UK and Europe.

finance.desc: Get flexible finance for new and used refrigerated trailers. Competitive rates, fast approvals and tailored funding solutions for hauliers, fleets and owner?operators
finance.buyIntro: If you choose to purchase one of our refrigerated trailers or fridge units, we can organise the following:
buyList: Financing for up to 100% of purchase price
VAT payment can be deferred to match cash flow of VAT reclaim
Payment structure agreed at outset can be designed to match cash flow if required I.E seasonal payments for agricultural businesses
Final lump (balloon) payment can help reduce regular payments where it is deemed beneficial
partner: Refrigerated Trailer Services Ltd partners with a regulated finance brokerage that is an expert in financing trailers and trucks throughout the UK.
Ensuring you have access to expert guidance and competitive financing options tailored to your requirements and budget; including limited companies and sole traders/partnerships.
With our partnership, you can confidently explore our range of refrigerated trailers, knowing that we're committed to making the financing process seamless and straightforward for you.
Whether you're expanding your fleet or upgrading equipment, trust Refrigerated Trailer Services Ltd to provide reliable solutions that help you grow your business effectively.
hp: If a business wishes to buy equipment outright, Hire Purchase can provide a tailored and cost-effective alternative to loan or overdraft funding.

Hire Purchase enables your business to benefit from using the equipment straight away, but the payments can be spread over the life of the equipment. At the end of the term, ownership of the equipment is normally obtained for a nominal fee.
hpList: Financing for up to 100% of purchase price
VAT payment can be deferred to match cash flow of VAT reclaim
Payment structure agreed at outset can be designed to match cash flow if required I.E seasonal payments for agricultural businesses
Final lump (balloon) payment can help reduce regular payments where it is deemed beneficial
Equipment is then purchased for nominal fee at end of the term (option to purchase fee, typically £100)
fl: A flexible, tax-efficient way for your business to acquire the equipment it needs without using up valuable cash reserves. You may also realise almost all the equipment value at the end of the term.
flList: Financing for up to 100% of purchase price

Options to either continue renting equipment after the primary period, normally at reduced or nominal sum or, if permitted in the contract, sell the equipment and retain a proportion of the cash proceeds when the lease term ends (typically 97.5%)
VAT is payable on rentals so it is not necessary to pay VAT on equipment cost up front
Depending on asset type and term, it may be able to offset rental payments against profits and reduce tax liability
Payment structure agreed at outset can be designed to match cash flow if required
Final lump (or balloon) payment can help reduce regular payments where deemed beneficial
slb: A simple form of refinance, this is a facility which delivers a method of releasing equity in unencumbered assets or assets nearing the end of their original finance arrangements.
The result is a cash injection into your working capital (after paying off any outstanding finance from other finance companies) to be used as required.
The nature of the new agreement will be the same as the Finance Lease or Hire Purchase product in terms of structure and tax allowances, depending on the option applied.
finance.cta: To discuss your finance options through RTS contact us today.

sell.title: Sell Your Refrigerated Trailer, RTS UK
sell.desc: Looking to sell your refrigerated trailer? Refrigerated Trailer Services can offer part?exchange, outright purchase or fleet buyouts, get in touch with RTS to find out more.
sell.tagline: We take the good, the bad and even the ugly!
intro: Refrigerated Trailer Services are constantly looking to purchase quality used trailers, from just a single unit to an entire fleet of 100 trailers or more. If we are purchasing your trailers as part of a fleet, unlike many dealers who may just cherry-pick the good trailers, we'll take the bad ones too, making your disposal as smooth and straight forward as possible.
px: If you are purchasing a new trailer we would have no problem working with your chosen manufacturer to take your trailer in part-exchange.
This is a good option if you are depending on the value of the used trailer to go towards the deposit for your new equipment.
It enables you to use the trailer right up until the day the new one is available, avoiding the need to sell it in advance, pay potential rent or accumulate additional expense.
leased: We can also assist with purchasing trailers which are still on lease or finance, whether it be due to the unexpected end of a contract or to help avoid any expensive return conditions that maybe enforced.
In addition, if your assets are worth more than what is owed, we can return you the balance as a profit.
fridge: Along with the purchase of used trailers, RTS are also interested in Carrier and Thermo King used refrigeration units and we can collect these units directly from your premises if required.
Many trailers or trucks will have a refrigeration unit, even if the goods being carried do not require it.
Removing the unit will reduce the weight of your trailer, save you fuel and earn you money.
If you do not have the skills or facilities to do this on site, we will be more than happy to arrange this for you.
